author: Sofia Alvarez
title: Best & Worst Celebrity Style: June 2025
text:
London, June 18, 2025
Hollywood’s Hottest and Misses of June 2025 From princess moments to questionable ensembles, June 2025 has been a rollercoaster of red carpet fashion . Here’s a peek at the best and worst celebrity style moments so far this month.
Scarlett Johansson wowed in baby pink at a premiere in london. Keke Palmer rocked vintage Chanel at the BET Awards. cynthia Nixon’s outfit was a miss, while Sydney Sweeney hit a princess moment. What’s the buzz in celebrity fashion this June? The red carpets have been sizzling with star power, and the outfits have been a mixed bag of hits and misses. From the sleek to the questionable, we’ve got the lowdown on who’s wearing what.
The Hits Scarlett Johansson turned heads on June 17, 2025, at the Jurassic World Rebirth premiere in London. The actress stunned in a strapless baby pink Vivienne Westwood gown that accentuated her figure.
Style Insight: Baby pink is making a comeback! This soft hue is perfect for summer events and adds a touch of elegance to any look. On June 10, 2025, Sydney Sweeney embraced her inner princess at the European premiere of Echo Valley in London, wearing a baby blue Miu Miu gown.
Leighton Meester was a vision in white on June 11, 2025, at the premiere of the Apple TV+ series The Buccaneers in New York City. Her whimsical Giambattista Valli LWD was the perfect summer look.
On June 9,2025,Keke Palmer topped the best-dressed list at the BET Awards in Los Angeles in a vintage Chanel minidress from 1993. Also at the BET Awards, Ciara stunned in a Cong Tri ensemble.
Miley Cyrus embraced a fantastic Schiaparelli look at the Tribeca Festival premiere of her musical film Something Lovely in New York City on June 6, 2025. Her crystal-adorned dress was a showstopper.
On June 6,2025,Lucy Liu donned a floral Monique Lhuillier gown at the Tribeca Festival premiere of rosemead in New York City,and on June 10,2025,Emily Blunt knocked it out of the park in a sienna-hued Elie Saab dress at the American Institute for Stuttering’s 19th Annual Gala in New York City.
The Misses Unfortunately, not every star hit the mark. Cynthia Nixon’s black Richard Quinn coat-dress at the Tribeca Festival premiere of The Gilded Age on June 12, 2025, was a fashion misstep. Some thought it resembled a “trash bag.”
Fashion Faux Pas: Be careful with oversized silhouettes! What looks avant-garde on the runway can easily translate to unflattering in real life. Christina Aguilera sent mixed signals on June 9, 2025, at the Joylux and Playground “Bare It All” event in Santa Monica, California. her Blumarine getup left some wondering if she was headed straight from the office to an S&M club.
Katie Holmes’ Prada creation at this year’s Tony Awards in New York City on June 8, 2025, was also a fashion miss.
Other Notable Mentions Ana de armas dazzled in a lovely lilac Louis Vuitton gown at a special screening of Ballerina in Los Angeles on June 3, 2025.
Whoopi Goldberg’s style was on full display at the Tribeca Festival opening night premiere of HBO’s Billy Joel: And So It Goes in New York City on June 4, 2025.
On June 1, 2025, Uzo Aduba stunned in a fuchsia dress at the 85th Annual peabody Awards, while Anna Kendrick wowed in a magenta gown. Sutton Foster looked great at the Drama Desk Awards.
Sarah Hyland pulled off an all-brown ensemble at the Drama Desk Awards.
Trends to watch: The 2025 Tony Awards and Beyond The star power of celebrity fashion isn’t limited to movie premieres and award shows. The 2025 Tony Awards, held on June 8th, showcased a different side of style, offering everything from classic elegance to daring statements. What trends are emerging, and what can we expect to see in the coming months?
Tony Awards highlights The 2025 Tony Awards red carpet was a playground for both established and up-and-coming designers.While katie Holmes’ Prada ensemble didn’t make the “best dressed” list, the event provided plenty of inspiration.
Suits: Several male celebrities opted for classic suits, showcasing traditional styles and updated silhouettes. “Suits, whether classic or contemporary, remain a solid choice for men,” shares fashion expert, Zoya James. A well-tailored suit is a timeless wardrobe staple.
Dresses: the gowns were diverse, with a mix of flowing silhouettes and structured designs. Expect to see more bold colors and unique embellishments in the coming months.
Statement Pieces: Don’t be afraid to embrace bold jewelry, dramatic sleeves, or eye-catching details. This is how stars stand out!
Beyond the Red Carpet: What’s Next? The fashion moments of June 2025 offer early clues about what to expect from fashion. The trends offer a unique and fascinating look into the future of style.
Practical Tips for Incorporating Trends:
Embrace Color: Don’t shy away from vibrant baby pink and sienna hues. Start with smaller accessories. Experiment with Textures: Incorporate different fabric choices. Play with Silhouettes: Update your wardrobe with current styles. Accessorize Strategically: add a boost to your outfits with bold choices. What’s next? We can expect to see many of these trends continue to evolve into the summer.The emphasis on individuality and self-expression will fuel the continuing evolution of style.
Are you wondering what the biggest trends of 2025 are? The fashion world is shifting,highlighting strong colors,bold silhouettes,and a wide mix of textures. Expect to see a continued embrace of both classic and experimental styles in the coming months.
How can you stay ahead of fashion trends? Paying close attention to red carpets, celebrity appearances, and fashion weeks is crucial. Follow fashion publications and influencers for a constant stream of inspiration.
The best of celebrity style in June is only a hint of fashion’s wider landscape. Stay tuned as more trends and moments come to be!
